content:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#
# Runs every check on x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux and aarch64-darwin. The job `check` runs
# the flake's checks (the fixtures and real projects built in the Nix
# sandbox, the unit tests of the lock run, the refused lockfiles of the
# purifier contract, the publish step and the formatting), their
# evaluation for every system, and the messages of common mistakes. The
# checks of the purifier contract that need the network or Nix itself run
# as jobs of their own names.
name: check

on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Flake checks
        run: nix flake check -L
      - name: Verify native Darwin execution
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: test "$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr builtins.currentSystem)" = aarch64-darwin
      - name: Evaluation for every system
        run: nix flake check --all-systems --no-build
      - name: Messages of common mistakes
        run: tests/errors.sh
      - name: Build and record named runtime derivations
        if: always()
        run: python3 tests/runtime-receipt.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-runtime-evidence"
      - name: Upload runtime derivation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: npm-runtime-${{ matrix.runner }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-runtime-evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn

  conformance:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
        check: [conformance-relock, conformance-rebuild, conformance-offline, conformance-update]
    name: ${{ matrix.check }} (${{ matrix.runner }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: ${{ matrix.check }}
        run: tests/${{ matrix.check }}.sh
      - name: Verify native Darwin execution
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: test "$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr builtins.currentSystem)" = aarch64-darwin

  composition-native:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - run: python3 tests/composition-native.py

  real-world-native:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Pinned commander ordinary and purified native workflows
        run: python3 tests/real-world-native.py
      - name: Verify native Darwin execution
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: test "$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr builtins.currentSystem)" = aarch64-darwin
      - name: Default SDK native publication and ordinary registry consumption
        run: python3 tests/node-lts-native.py --current
      - name: Current npm CLI native workflow
        run: python3 tests/node-lts-native.py --latest-npm

  legacy-native:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Selected native npm workflows and ordinary registry consumers
        run: python3 tests/node-lts-native.py
      - name: Native pre-package-lock shrinkwrap workflows
        run: python3 tests/shrinkwrap-native.py
      - name: SDK context without import from derivation
        run: nix eval --impure --option allow-import-from-derivation false --json --expr 'import ./tests/sdk-context.nix {}'
      - name: SDK recipe survives ordinary store copy
        run: python3 tests/sdk-portable.py
